localSource.FrostyFnv1_32: UTF-8 bytes; seed 5381; each byte: ((hash * 33) XOR byte) modulo 2^32. ASCII EBX reader/writer code uses same recurrence.
localSource.FrostyFnv1a_32: UTF-8 bytes; seed 5381; each byte: ((hash XOR byte) * 33) modulo 2^32.
localSource.FrostyFnv1_64: UTF-8; seed 14695981039346656037 and multiplier 1099511628211, multiplication then XOR, modulo 2^64.
localSource.FrostyFnv1a_64: Same 64-bit constants; XOR before multiplication. Matrix uses low32 only, labelled explicitly.
localSource.metadata: HashAttribute stores its supplied int. TypeLibrary.GetType builds a lookup with Fnv1.HashString(name or DisplayName).
